decision_rationale: The overwhelming consensus, supported by critical data points, necessitates a pause. The crash rate remains unacceptably high at 0.95, significantly exceeding the 0.75 threshold. This is compounded by an extremely high volume of support tickets (155 vs. a target of 80) and a concerning drop in 7-day retention (39.2 vs. 42.0), indicating a negative user experience. The payment success rate has also dropped to 97.8%, raising concerns about revenue impact and system stability. User feedback consistently highlights critical issues like data loss (KI-001), latency problems (KI-002), and inaccurate suggestions (KI-003), reflected in a negative Net Sentiment Score of -0.23. While the feature funnel completion shows a positive trend, it is insufficient to outweigh these severe stability and usability problems. The 'insufficient_data' trend for retention warrants further investigation and suggests potential masking of a more significant issue.
